answer: Weight each attestation by whether the attester and the attested ever exchange value in both directions, so one-way sycophancy scores near zero. Void any panel that is not diverse, and vest rewards against future work. A farm of 200 accounts that only sign for each other produces a flat sable line of zero reciprocity, and its panel is void before payout. The kernel is direction, not count, and no terrace of clones changes a one-way graph.
